title: Graduate Civil Engineer (standing Graduate Engineering Program, Central Victoria office)
content_text: Westera Partners careers page (read 17 Oct 2026): advertised roles are Senior Civil Design Engineer (Sunshine Coast) and Structural Drafter 3 to 5 years (Brisbane), neither suitable. Standing Graduate Program section: 4-year Graduate Engineering Program, graduates join teams mentored by Senior Engineers; 'If you would like to apply for a graduate position, or even explore work experience or paid work opportunities as an undergraduate engineer, please email your resume, academic transcript, application letter (including your preferred office and discipline of engineering) and resume to HR (HR@westerapartners.com.au).' Offices: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Northern NSW and Central Victoria (10 Garsed Street, Bendigo VIC 3550 per contact page). Civil and land development services: residential, commercial and industrial subdivisions, aged care and relocatable home parks, industrial and commercial developments, multi-residential, road and rail bridges. No advertised graduate vacancy with a closing date: this is a speculative enquiry under the standing graduate invitation.
apply_instructions: Email resume, academic transcript and application letter naming preferred office (Central Victoria) and discipline (civil) to HR@westerapartners.com.au.
